title: Ultra Lotto jackpot now P500.6 million; no winners of major lotto games on Nov. 8, 2026
summary: The jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game has crossed the half-a-billion-peso mark, but there were no winners of either of the major lotto games on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026.

blocks.text: The jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game has crossed the half-a-billion-peso mark, but there were no winners of either of the major lotto games on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026.

No bettor chose the winning combination of 22-14-01-42-09-08 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot, which has risen to P500,614,204.72. The Ultra Lotto prize has not been won since 10 bettors split the P76.3-million pot in May.
There was also no winner of the Superlotto 6/49 prize, which is now at P92,852,095.12. The winning combination was 34-39-38-18-47-36.
